data.one_liner: UI library for building Solid apps with Flutter, providing scaffold, auth, file, and permission widgets.
data.what_it_does: SolidUI offers a set of Flutter widgets tailored for Solid applications, including a custom scaffold, authentication widgets, file management, and permission UIs. It wraps solidpod functionality and adds responsive navigation and theming support.
use_when: You need to build a Solid-based Flutter app with authentication and file handling
You want ready-made widgets for navigation and permission management
You prefer a declarative UI approach
avoid_when: You are not using Solid or need a lightweight UI library
You require a different state‑management or backend solution
strengths: Ready‑to‑use widgets for auth, file, and permissions
weaknesses: Limited to Flutter (no web support documented)
data.setup_notes: Add solidui to pubspec.yaml and run flutter pub get. No build_runner or native permissions required.
